svg.title: A two-connection scan of recurrent neural dynamics

cc:Work.dc:title: A two-connection scan of recurrent neural dynamics
cc:Work.dc:description: Two categorical maps show the declared control rectangles. Each cell uses its saved full-state peak-event period. A dashed rectangle locates the focus. Selected coordinates share markers between panels. Unmeasured cells are gray and no-short-period cells are pale.
